mapper.select: SELECT recognition.id AS recognition_task_id, recognition.recognition_no, task.id AS reading_task_id, task.task_no AS reading_task_no, task.task_status AS reading_task_status, image.id AS image_id, image.original_name AS image_original_name, image.image_type, image.image_status, image.storage_status AS image_storage_status, meter.id AS meter_id, meter.meter_no, meter.meter_name, meter.meter_type, meter.unit, recognition.attempt_no, recognition.status, recognition.result_id, recognition.recognized_value, recognition.confidence, recognition.model_name, recognition.model_version, recognition.raw_result, recognition.failure_code, recognition.failure_message, recognition.retry_count, recognition.max_retry_count, recognition.started_at, recognition.completed_at, recognition.processing_duration_ms, recognition.cancel_reason, recognition.cancelled_by, canceller.display_name AS cancelled_by_name, recognition.cancelled_at, recognition.version, recognition.created_at, recognition.updated_at, outbox.event_id AS latest_event_id, outbox.status AS latest_outbox_status, outbox.retry_count AS latest_outbox_retry_count, outbox.max_retry_count AS latest_outbox_max_retry_count, outbox.next_retry_at AS latest_outbox_next_retry_at, outbox.sent_at AS latest_outbox_sent_at, outbox.last_error AS latest_outbox_last_error FROM ai_recognition_task AS recognition INNER JOIN meter_reading_task AS task ON task.id = recognition.reading_task_id INNER JOIN meter_image AS image ON image.id = recognition.image_id INNER JOIN meter ON meter.id = recognition.meter_id LEFT JOIN sys_user AS canceller ON canceller.id = recognition.cancelled_by LEFT JOIN mq_outbox_event AS outbox ON outbox.id = ( SELECT MAX(latest.id) FROM mq_outbox_event AS latest WHERE latest.aggregate_type = 'AI_RECOGNITION_TASK' AND latest.aggregate_id = recognition.id ) WHERE recognition.id = #{recognitionTaskId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_recognition_task WHERE id = #{recognitionTaskId} FOR UPDATE
